work.description: The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. Independent DXXXVII heading 74171 and split synopsis 74174–74176/74191–74194 lead to the actual Urbanus self-protocol 74196–74200; the catalog protocol at 74230 is a narrative reference to Innocentius III. Ordered exordium and §§1–12 run to 74613, with full/short dating 74615–74620 and next DXXXVIII 74623. The previous act's historical notes 74178–74186 are explicitly about assignatores/§7 and its dating, so are excluded by disjoint selection; own notes 74236–74240, 74298–74302, 74350–74354 and 74412–74413 remain. No inserted act or body reversal found.
